 return row

 while now()<start:
  (D/'status.txt').write_text('等待窗口 '+now().isoformat()+'\nSTART '+start.isoformat()+'\nEND '+end.isoformat()+'\n')
  time.sleep(min(60,max(0,(start-now()).total_seconds())))
 nextcheck=start
 while now()<=end:

  row=mem('10-minute start gate');row['eligible']=row['available_kib']>=14*1024*1024
  with (D/'gate.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')

  if row['eligible']:gate=True;break
  nextcheck+=datetime.timedelta(minutes=10)
 if not gate:
  reason='window ended without MemAvailable >=14GiB'
 else:
  (D/'wait-end.txt').write_text('已结束 '+now().isoformat()+' 成功（启动条件满足）\n')
  (D/'status.txt').write_text('BUILDING '+now().isoformat()+'\n')
  with (D/'build.log').open('w') as log:
   p=subprocess.Popen(['systemd-run','--user','--scope','--unit='+unit,'-p','MemoryMax=10G','-p','CPUQuota=400%','python3','-u',str(D/'build_child.py')],stdout=log,stderr=log,start_new_session=True)
   nextsample=time.monotonic();cg=None
   while p.poll() is None:
    if time.monotonic()>=nextsample:
     row=mem('60-second build monitor');nextsample+=60
     low=low+1 if row['available_kib']<3*1024*1024 else 0
     with (D/'processes.txt').open('a') as f:

     if low>=2:

      p.wait();break
    if cg is None:
     v=subprocess.run(['systemctl','--user','show',unit+'.scope','-p','ControlGroup','--value'],text=True,capture_output=True).stdout.strip()
     if v:cg=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/v.lstrip('/')
    if cg:
     try:peak=max(peak,int((cg/'memory.peak').read_text()),int((cg/'memory.current').read_text()))
     except (FileNotFoundError,ValueError):pass
    time.sleep(1)
   rc=p.wait()
  j=json.loads((D/'build-result.json').read_text()) if (D/'build-result.json').exists() else {}
  state='成功' if rc==0 and j.get('gbs_exit')==0 else '失败'

except BaseException as e:

 if p and p.poll() is None:

 state='失败' if gate else '未开始'
finally:
 stamp=now().isoformat()
 if not (D/'wait-end.txt').exists():(D/'wait-end.txt').write_text('已结束 '+stamp+' 未开始 '+reason+'\n')

  with (D/'build.log').open('a') as f:f.write('已结束 '+stamp+' 失败 GBS真实退出码未取得 '+reason+'\nALL-END '+stamp+' FAILED\n')
